evidence: The paper trains random forest classifiers as one of two diagnostic methods being compared using AUC and two-way partial AUC (tpAUC) metrics. The methodology focuses on classifier performance evaluation through ROC analysis. No variable importance measures, impurity-based importance, feature importance, or variable selection methods are mentioned, described, or used in the analysis. Random forests are used solely as a predictive classifier whose output probabilities feed into AUC computation, not as a source of importance rankings.
